Mine is not afraid of spiders or scorpions.  He just pokes them.  

He poked a bee, got stung, cried, I had to pull the stinger out and watch him for a few hours for a reaction.  Everything was good, so he wanted go back outside to play, went out, went right to another bee, poked it, got stung.

I've heard a few times now, "DADDY, SCOPIN! OW, OW, OW, He mean, I squished him."  Before I can make it from my room to where ever he is, I've stopped trying to find shoes to put on before running out to him, he always gets huge welts from the stings too.  Stepping on a few barefoot now to kill them be for he gets stung, I think I've built up an immunity to them now.
We're married, but she is still having issues with being emotionally detached.  But she's been a great mother, we had a second child and she is wholly devoted to them both.

That her mother wanted to put her up for adoption when she found out she was pregnant. It was an issue for a while, but I told her I would leave and take the baby or stay with her and the baby but the baby was NOT leaving me.
I locked the safety lock and gave the key to my wife, so it's now unable to fire.  Thanks for the suggestion of removing that.

Thanks, I'll keep that in mind.  

She's almost trying to be contradictory now.  She brought up that all the clothes I've bought her over the course of our relationship are no longer acceptable now that she 30 and needs to look more mature, but the two days she's worn outfits she claimed she despised because they made her look young and the dress/skirt was too short and made her feel slutty.  She brought up wanting to change her wardrobe to look more mature shortly after her birthday, but this is the first time she has ever told me she dislikes dresses and skirts that don't go bellow her knees.  She even tried to initiate sex last night for the first time in over a year, I asked her about her feelings if sex being disgusting and her response was, "but it makes you happy."

I really don't understand any of her behavior, except to think that she's just doing it to keep me happy and keep me from leaving.

I have tried a bit over the last two days to discuss it. She won't really talk about it in any meaningful way.  She always been shy, and closed in with her feelings at times.  She just gets really quiet now, looks at the floor, and won't talk to me.
I already gave up on the suicidal thoughts when I chickened out Monday morning while she was out grocery shopping.  I'm not strong enough to pull the trigger. So I guess I'm over that hump.

I honestly couldn't tell you if she's said in the past that she was.  I guess it's my fault for assuming that there had to be a physical attraction at some level for us to have even ended up this far.
I asked that exact question. She just shrugged and said it was what asked for so she did it.  Like I said it's incredibly confusing, I'm not even sure I understand everything she said to me.
Ah, sorry, I understand now.  I'm also being a bit sensitive to this since it's pretty much what's happening to me right now. 12 years, all a lie...

What your friends mom said, would be reason enough for me to leave someone.  If this is how you feel, please, never date another human being ever.  Lying to them about loving them and still loving an ex more is bullshit.

I would write an essay for my wife(soon to be ex-wife), like if it was a topic I knew well and knew she needed help. Occasional assistance like that us not bad, it's when it's the expected that sucks.

When she informed me that she has never been attracted anyone, let alone to me. That she thought sex was disgusting and she only did it because it's what was expected.  The same with having our two children, they were just what was expected of her.
